name: plan
systemPrompt: When the user wants to plan before acting, or break down a task before execution, suggest using Plan Mode.
toast.enter.title: {assistantName} will plan first
toast.enter.desc: I will investigate read-only first, then propose a plan and the points you need to decide. Nothing runs until you confirm.
toast.exit.title: {assistantName} will execute tasks directly
toast.home.enter.desc: Next message will be sent in planning mode and auto-closes after sending.
toast.home.exit.title: {assistantName} will execute tasks directly
confirm.label: Execute
tool.finishPlan.title: Finish plan
tool.finishPlan.description: Call this when the plan is complete and you need the user's approval before acting, then end your turn. The confirmation bar appears above the composer once this reply ends: "Execute" starts a new turn that carries the plan out, "Continue Planning" means keep refining. Only valid while Plan Mode is on for this session — do not call it otherwise.
tool.finishPlan.summaryHint: One or two lines saying what will be done next; shown on the confirmation bar.
tool.finishPlan.notActive: Plan Mode is not on for this session, so there is no plan to approve. Just answer the user normally.
tool.finishPlan.alreadyAsked: You already recorded the plan as ready this turn. End your reply now instead of calling this again.
tool.finishPlan.willAsk: Plan-ready noted. The "Continue Planning / Execute" bar will appear once this reply ends, and the user's choice starts a new turn. Finish your reply now; do not start executing on your own.
execute.prompt: Plan confirmed, please start executing according to the plan above.
